verdict.rationale: Zamzar is a file-conversion API and web service. A buyer could reasonably ask whether such a service offers saved, versioned conversion workflows, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers one-off conversion jobs, SDKs, authentication and a sandbox endpoint. Nothing shows saved automations, version history, review, or rollback. The sandbox endpoint is a test environment, not versioning or rollback of automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
